payload.description:
## Finding
2026-11-18: main CI (e6d136ec, quality-gates) failed at release-notes after basicly-uora5dm.1 landed. release_note_standing.py:44 reads tracker.all_records, which catches ValueError and returns an empty list (src/basicly/tracker.py:797); RecordsInCIError derived from ValueError, so the guard refusal was swallowed and the check judged an empty tracker. Locally the guard never fired in a worktree, because the engine resolves the ledger redirect to the main checkout, outside the guarded root, so the lane proof was not valid for record readers.
payload.title: CI mode swallowed its own refusal and missed reads through a worktree redirect

payload.acceptance_criteria: When the ledger read inside all_records fails, then the caller sees a named error instead of an empty list, and each caller that needs an empty result handles a named condition.
payload.description:
## Context
When a check reads tracker records and the read fails, I want the failure named, so no check passes by judging against an empty tracker.

## Finding
src/basicly/tracker.py:797 all_records catches TrackerDivergenceError, OSError and ValueError and returns an empty list; the catch dates from db5619d6 (2026-08-18, the owned-ledger migration) and its history names no specific error. 2026-11-18 evidence: the CI guard error, then a ValueError, was swallowed and release-notes judged an empty tracker (basicly-uora5dm.3). Any other ValueError on the read path fails open the same way. Filed on the Orchestrator's order of 2026-11-18.
payload.title: Stop all_records from turning any ValueError into an empty tracker
